function.arguments: {"message":"Yes – data that’s older than the dashboard’s default view can still be accessed. On your workspace go to **Settings → Reporting → Extended history**; this page shows any extended retention your current plan includes and explains how to request data that isn’t shown by default. If your plan doesn’t automatically display a longer window, you can submit a request and the data (which is kept in cold storage rather than deleted) will be provided. For usage data, you can also export older periods by selecting a custom date range in the export tool, as long as the dates fall within your overall retention window."}

arguments.message: Yes – data that’s older than the dashboard’s default view can still be accessed. On your workspace go to **Settings → Reporting → Extended history**; this page shows any extended retention your current plan includes and explains how to request data that isn’t shown by default. If your plan doesn’t automatically display a longer window, you can submit a request and the data (which is kept in cold storage rather than deleted) will be provided. For usage data, you can also export older periods by selecting a custom date range in the export tool, as long as the dates fall within your overall retention window.
